title: 📢 ITR Filing Due Date Extended to 15th September
html:
The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) has officially extended the due date for filing Income Tax Returns for AY 2026-27.

CategoryOriginal DateNew Date
Non-Audit Taxpayers (u/s 139(1))31st July 202615th September 2026

This extension applies to all individual, HUF, and non-audit entity filings. Please update your clients accordingly.

🔗 View Official Notification on incometax.gov.in

title: 📋 GST Portal Scheduled Maintenance
body:
The GST portal will be under scheduled maintenance on 5th August 2026 from 12:00 AM to 6:00 AM IST.

During this window, filing services (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9) will be temporarily unavailable.

Please plan your filings accordingly.
